description: Both Gemma formatters append a literal placeholder instead of the supplied system text.
trigger: Call Gemma2Model.default_chat_prompt or Gemma3Model.default_chat_prompt with a nonempty system_prompt; Gemma3TextModel inherits the latter.
expected_behavior: Include the supplied system content in the returned prompt.
actual_behavior: The ordinary string "{system_prompt}\n\n" is appended, so the supplied content is absent and the placeholder is visible. Whole-parent-tree search found no existing callers, so the established reach is direct use of the new API, not existing chat workflows.

verification.description: Transcribed the identical Gemma string construction with None, empty and nonempty system prompts. The nonempty case retained {system_prompt} and omitted 'Follow safety rules'.
verification.limits: Standard-library Python string check, not execution of either repository class or a model.
